1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju (Persimpangan

Bertingkat Bandar Ainsdale) 2015.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Julai 2015.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan suatu kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang melebihi had

laju yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama di atas jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) dilarang.

(2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan di bawah subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (BANDAR AINSDALE INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Bandar Ainsdale

Interchange) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 10 July 2015.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding the speed limit as

specified in column (2) of the First Schedule on the road specified in column (1) is

prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Second Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

Grid.
